def _predict_chamber(taus, theta, split, features, times, projection):
    hold = split['hold_channel_raw'] @ projection[0] + projection[1]
    drift = theta[2] + features @ theta[3:]
    response = -np.expm1(-times[:, None] / taus) @ theta[:2]
